activities.title: Normalize Query Axes
activities.description: Validate and normalize unified search params (cpc/ipc/keyword/applicant/inventor_country/pub_number/date/countries/num/skip) into a backend-neutral QuerySpec; fail-fast on invalid params.

activities.title: Select Source Ladder Rung
activities.description: Route the QuerySpec down the source priority ladder GPSS -> EPO -> PPUBS -> (gated) gpatents using configured() availability and the axis capability matrix; USPC (CCL/) axis goes direct to PPUBS; gpatents is gated by allow_scraping (default False).

activities.title: Execute Backend Search
activities.description: Run the backend-native query on the chosen rung under client throttling (GPSS single-thread+sleep, EPO 15/min two-phase search+biblio, PPUBS run_query, gated GooglePatents tail); emit raw hits and a per-rung attempt result.

activities.title: Normalize Records & Assemble Provenance
activities.description: Map raw backend hits into the unified record schema (screening_table.py) with honest-gap discipline and assemble the {records, source, provenance, gaps} envelope, one provenance entry per attempted rung.
